officialTitle: Pembrolizumab plus Chemotherapy in Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: we randomly assigned (in a 2:1 ratio) 616 patients with metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC without sensitizing EGFR or ALK mutations
design.notes: Crossover to pembrolizumab monotherapy permitted at verified progression in the placebo-combination group.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding pembrolizumab to pemetrexed-platinum improve OS and PFS in first-line metastatic non-squamous NSCLC without EGFR/ALK alterations?

pico.population: Previously untreated metastatic non-squamous NSCLC without sensitising EGFR or ALK alterations
pico.intervention: Pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed and a platinum-based drug for 4 cycles, then pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed maintenance
pico.comparator: Placebo plus pemetrexed and a platinum-based drug, then placebo plus pemetrexed maintenance (crossover permitted)
pico.outcomes: Dual primary: OS and BICR PFS. Safety

arms.label: Pembrolizumab-combination
arms.regimen: Pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed and platinum, then pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed maintenance
arms.dosing: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks for 4 cycles with chemotherapy, then up to a total of 35 cycles
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive pemetrexed and a platinum-based drug plus either 200 mg of pembrolizumab or placebo every 3 weeks for 4 cycles, followed by pembrolizumab or placebo for up to a total of 35 cycles plus pemetrexed maintenance therapy

arms.label: Placebo-combination
arms.regimen: Placebo plus pemetrexed and platinum, then placebo plus pemetrexed maintenance

publications.title: Pembrolizumab plus Chemotherapy in Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis

publications.title: Updated Analysis From KEYNOTE-189: Pembrolizumab or Placebo Plus Pemetrexed and Platinum for Previously Untreated Metastatic Nonsquamous Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Updated analysis (median follow-up 23.1 months)

outcomes.sourceQuote: After a median follow-up of 10.5 months, the estimated rate of overall survival at 12 months was 69.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], 64.1 to 73.8) in the pembrolizumab-combination group versus 49.4% (95% CI, 42.1 to 56.2) in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio for death, 0.49; 95% CI, 0.38 to 0.64; P<0.001).

outcomes.endpointLabel: PFS by blinded independent central review
outcomes.sourceQuote: Median progression-free survival was 8.8 months (95% CI, 7.6 to 9.2) in the pembrolizumab-combination group and 4.9 months (95% CI, 4.7 to 5.5) in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.52; 95% CI, 0.43 to 0.64; P<0.001).

As of September 21, 2018 (median follow-up, 23.1 months), the updated median (95% CI) OS was 22.0 (19.5 to 25.2) months in the pembrolizumab-combination group versus 10.7 (8.7 to 13.6) months in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio [HR], 0.56; 95% CI, 0.45 to 0.70]).
Median (95% CI) PFS was 9.0 (8.1 to 9.9) months and 4.9 (4.7 to 5.5) months, respectively (HR, 0.48; 95% CI, 0.40 to 0.58).

Median (95% CI) time from randomization to objective tumor progression on next-line treatment or death from any cause, whichever occurred first (progression-free-survival-2; PFS-2) was 17.0 (15.1 to 19.4) months and 9.0 (7.6 to 10.4) months, respectively (HR, 0.49; 95% CI, 0.40 to 0.59).

safety.description: Adverse events of grade 3 or higher (primary analysis)
safety.sourceQuote: Adverse events of grade 3 or higher occurred in 67.2% of the patients in the pembrolizumab-combination group and in 65.8% of those in the placebo-combination group.
Incidence of grade 3-5 adverse events was similar in the pembrolizumab-combination (71.9%) and placebo-combination (66.8%) groups.

strengths: OS benefit across PD-L1 categories, maintained at updated analysis
limitations: Updated analysis had no alpha assigned

clinicalImplications.text: Established pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed-platinum as a first-line standard for metastatic non-squamous NSCLC without EGFR/ALK alterations, irrespective of PD-L1 expression.

tumourBoardPearl.text: The chemo-immunotherapy OS benefit held across PD-L1 strata, including PD-L1-negative tumours.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from PubMed abstracts of PMID 29658856 (primary) and PMID 32150489 (updated analysis). Arm n from updated analysis abstract (n = 410 / n = 206).
